headline: PPWR names chemicals in three rows and reaches it in five — but regulates the buyer of 11.3% of its output on 82 of 89 rows
Seven sectors carry more than 70 duty-side rows; six of them get 30 to 51 benefit-side rows — plastics converting gets 5
The ETS revision names eight sectors and reaches eleven — aluminium, cement and power are covered without being named once
The CBAM extension never names automotive, but reaches it seven times through the combined-metal-products category
